summary: DOB 是相对少见的合成迷幻剂，以极低剂量和长持续时间著称。历史上很少被刻意服用，但曾被当作 LSD 贩售，如今在研究化学品圈也有一定地位。
effectsSummary: DOB is a potent and long-lasting psychedelic. Visual hallucinations, altered perception of time, ego dissolution. Onset can take up to 2-3 hours.
generalRisks: Dangerous increase in blood pressure. Risk of panic attacks and psychological distress. Overheating risk. Extremely long duration (up to 24h+).
longtermRisks: No research results on long-term risks. HPPD possible. The main risk is psychological distress during the experience.
saferUse: 只使用毫克秤精确测量剂量。
安排清醒的陪护人在场。
确保有充足的时间（至少 24 小时）。
避免与其他药物混合使用。
从低剂量开始，逐步增加。
[TBT] Mixed use of these potent substances should be avoided at all costs.

[TBT] As amphetamine derivatives, DOB can be particularly draining because of their long duration of action. Light vitamin-rich food, fruits, vegetable juices, vitamins and minerals promote a soft landing after the trip has subsided and can weaken a hangover.
[TBT] Plan enough time for recovery after the trip (at least 1 day)!
[TBT] A trip with DOB should remain an exceptional experience. Make sure to take long breaks from consumption so that the experience can be processed.
